Seller.title: Seller
Seller.description: Represents a seller in the Koop application.

ownerId.description: The UID of the user who owns this seller profile. Optional for prototyping.

courseName.description: The name of the golf course or establishment.

type.description: The type of establishment for the seller.

menuTypes.description: The service types/menu categories enabled for this seller.

halfwayHouseCount.description: Number of halfway houses if applicable.

laneCount.description: Number of bowling lanes if applicable.

streetAddress.description: The street address of the establishment.

city.description: The city where the establishment is located.

state.description: The state where the establishment is located.

zip.description: The postal/zip code of the establishment.

latitude.description: The latitude of the golf course.

longitude.description: The longitude of the golf course.

contactName.description: The primary contact person for the seller.

contactEmail.description: The contact email address for the seller.

contactPhone.description: The contact phone number for the seller.

serviceFee.description: The service fee charged by the seller.

status.description: The current status of the seller.

MenuItem.title: MenuItem
MenuItem.description: Represents a single item on a menu.

id.description: Unique identifier for the menu item entity.

name.description: The name of the menu item (e.g., 'Bud Light', 'Chips').

description.description: A description of the menu item.

price.description: The price of the menu item.

category.description: The category of the menu item.

rank.description: The display order of the menu item within its category.

Member.title: Member
Member.description: Represents a club member for Private/Semi-Private courses.

status.description: Whether the member account is active and can be charged.

sellerId.description: The ID of the seller this order belongs to.

customerId.description: The ID of the customer who placed the order.

memberId.description: The ID of the member if paymentMethod is Member Account.

memberLastName.description: The last name of the member if paymentMethod is Member Account.

deliveredAt.description: The time when the order was successfully delivered.
